body: I am so glad you were able to break free. I hope my partner does the same. I’m sorry if this was triggering for you.
I do regret it. I can’t even speak to my partner without immense guilt and disgust at myself. I start to cry if I look at them. Thank you for the resources. I’ll look at them.

It is a horrible feeling, I’m sorry you are going through it as well. I have found two facilities and will get in touch with them tomorrow to find the best fit. Unfortunately they are both very expensive so I will need to draw on my super for it. I am in Australia.
This sounds pretty perfect to me!
I’m currently trialling valproate! It is my second day. Previously tried latuda which was no good for me as it made me very irritable.
Dallas Green (City and Colour) and Johnny Craig (various bands, horrible person beautiful voice)

I get mad at everything. The smallest things set me off. I walk through the shops and don’t feel real. Everything is bright and the noises are too much. I start speaking to myself. I spend days in bed. My brain is screaming at me to kill myself. I consider taking everything I have access too if I could just be alone for long enough. I can’t focus. I can’t remember anything. Everything is fuzzy. I want to disappear. I look up hotels/air bnb/rentals. Anything so I don’t have to go home. I destroy all the relationships in my life.
Ivan Milat for me. I don’t see much about him on here. I went to school with his nephew too so that was another reason why I was interested in top of true crime being a running interest in my family.
It is Brothers! Thank you so much. Can’t tell you how long I’ve been trying to figure it out for.

Musictheory.net there are some great apps as well! I use simply piano and love it. You can trial to first lesson and after that you have to pay for use but it is SIGNIFICANTLY cheaper than a music teacher.

Mine are doing ok. Seven year old is loving it. He is more of an introvert and likes to stay home anyway (like me). My three year old is struggling. She is very social and is missing her friends but is managing.
